title: Three colors at one vertex
description: Fold the six exterior faces and compare the printed markings.

difficulty.label: Uncalibrated
difficulty.basis: Track face identities and the cyclic order at a vertex.

question: The net is shown from the printed side. Place that side down before folding upward, so the markings face outward. The left image is the net of a small cube, with its six faces painted different colors. The net is folded upwards to form the cube. Which of the following adjacent color combinations is possible when viewing the cube from an isometric perspective? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

options.label: D
options.text: All three other options are incorrect

annotation.Question: The left image is the net of a small cube, with its six faces painted different colors. The net is folded upwards to form the cube. Which of the following adjacent color combinations is possible when viewing the cube from an isometric perspective? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.
Choices: All three other options are incorrect

Explanation.B: Assuming the base is the square in the 2nd row, 1st column of the net, and the right face is the one to the right of the base. Option B is incorrect because it is the Back-Top-Right view mirrored horizontally.
Explanation.A: Assuming the base is the square in the 2nd row, 1st column of the net, and the right face is the one to the right of the base. Option A is incorrect because it is the Front-Top-Right view mirrored horizontally.
Explanation.ABCD: After folding the net, the front face is Pink, the back is Green, the left is Blue, the right is Cyan, the top is Red, and the bottom is Yellow.
Explanation.C: Option C is correct because it shows the Front-Top-Left view.

answer.explanation: Reading the net from its upper left, the top, left and right faces come from cyan (column 2, row 1 from the upper left), then pink (column 2, row 2 from the upper left), then yellow (column 3, row 2 from the upper left). All three markings retain the pictured orientation.

options.label: A
options.explanation: The three faces meet, but cyan (column 2, row 1 from the upper left), red (column 1, row 1 from the upper left), green (column 4, row 2 from the upper left) in top/left/right order reverses their order around the vertex.

options.label: B
options.explanation: The three faces meet, but green (column 4, row 2 from the upper left), red (column 1, row 1 from the upper left), blue (column 2, row 3 from the upper left) in top/left/right order reverses their order around the vertex.

options.label: C
options.explanation: Reading the net from its upper left, the top, left and right faces come from cyan (column 2, row 1 from the upper left), then pink (column 2, row 2 from the upper left), then yellow (column 3, row 2 from the upper left). All three markings retain the pictured orientation.

options.label: D
options.explanation: At least one pictured view is possible.
